provenance.title: Carta Administrativa Oficial de Portugal — serviço CAOP_DGT
provenance.idMethod: Continental identifiers use source DICO. Island identifiers are internal stable region-name identifiers, not official administrative codes.
provenance.islandMethod: Official parish geometries grouped by the exact source Concelho field into municipality MultiPolygons. Internal parish boundaries were not dissolved; draw same-fill polygons without internal outlines.
provenance.anchorMethod: Area-weighted centroid computed from supplied WGS84 polygons, accepted only if inside original and simplified municipality. Otherwise an interior centroid or interior grid point in the largest polygon is used. These are cartographic municipality anchors, not settlement centres or exact incident locations.
provenance.generalisation: Municipal display geometries additionally simplified by Douglas-Peucker, tolerance 0.0075 degrees. Small rings retained when simplification would collapse them. Anchors validated against original and display geometry.
provenance.scale: Continente, Açores and Madeira use separate panels with independent display scales. Madeira geometry includes Selvagens.
provenance.versionLimit: The service does not clearly declare the CAOP edition. No year of edition is asserted.
provenance.backgroundGeneralisation: Regional background polygons additionally simplified with tolerance 0.03 degrees for mainland and 0.006 degrees for islands. Small rings are preserved. Municipality boundaries use the finer tolerance stated above.
